mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% QoQ and the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% MoM and the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight monetary policy combined with a strong labor market signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 5% and UNRATE is below 4%, and the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases for three consecutive months and the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases by more than 10% MoM and the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is consistently below 2% and the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
